metrics.name: peak_load_lbs
metrics.notes: Presentation result rounds m * g-factor * g0 / 4.448 to whole pounds-force.

metrics.name: safety_factor
metrics.notes: Presentation result rounds rated strength divided by static load to one decimal place.

metrics.name: strain_energy_J
metrics.notes: Linear-elastic strain-energy proxy rounds to one decimal place.

source.title: Static ejection-load screening derivation
source.citation: Newton's second law and linear-elastic strain-energy relation.
source.derivation: Compute F = m * g-factor * g0; use k = rated force / extension and U = F^2 / (2*k). Values are compared after the product's documented presentation rounding.

comparison.decisionRule: Observed rounded screening metrics equal the independently derived static-screening values.

notes: Analytic regression for a simplified screening proxy only; not a dynamic deployment-load test or certification result.
